text:
sara: Quick heads-up — propose lifting the runtime pin for runtime v3.6 (kvcache fix) to a 5% canary at 00:10 UTC. No SDK change in this wave. Dry-run first.

mike: +1. Concrete timers and gates? whos on-call?

alicia: Dry-run at 23:30 UTC (no traffic) then canary 00:10 -> 5% -> 20m watch. Gates: p95 < 380ms, 5xx rate < 0.3%, smoke-eval must pass; token emit failures < 5 spikes/min. If token-drop spikes or smoke fails, abort.

deploybot: Deploybot: I can run the dry-run and post a gate report. Sample command: `/unpin runtime=v3.6 --cohort=dryrun --dry-run --gates=/etc/deploy/gates/rt-3.6-canary.yaml --report-channel=eng-releases`.

mike: PromQL snippets to include in gates file: 
`histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(redwood_runtime_request_duration_seconds_bucket{runtime="v3.6"}[5m])) by (le))`
and 5xx rate: `sum(rate(redwood_runtime_requests_total{runtime="v3.6",code=~"5.."}[5m])) / sum(rate(redwood_runtime_requests_total{runtime="v3.6"}[5m]))`

alicia: Rollback ladder: 1) immediate route throttle to weight=0 for v3.6 (`/route set-weight runtime=v3.6 weight=0 --cohort=canary`) 2) flip feature flag if present 3) `/deploybot rollback runtime=v3.6` and open PT. Manual rollback allowed with `/deploybot rollback runtime=v3.6 --reason="manual triage"`.

sara: On-call: @tim primary, @lucy secondary. Add tenant exclusions for payments partners in the gates file so they stay on v3.x.

tim: I'll take the window and watch the canary dashboard. If I see p95 creeping toward 420ms I'll throttle first.

alicia: QA smoke set queued for dry-run; webhook will post pass/fail.

sara: Release note blurb: "Canary: Runtime v3.6 (kvcache fix) to 5% with tenant exclusions. Auto-abort/route-throttle guards in place. Contact eng-releases for issues." I'll pin the runbook link in channel before dry-run.

deploybot: Dry-run scheduled at 1746605400 (23:30 UTC). Tentative canary at 1746609000 (00:10 UTC) pending explicit go after gate-report. I will post gate-report artifact here.

sara: Thanks team — will wait for dry-run report and then sign off. Ping here or page if anything looks off. :thumbsup:
